text:
alex: Heads up — ap-south-1 GPU queues for mosaic-13b-8k are spiking. Per-model queue depth went from ~12 to ~120 in the last 6m. Admission control started rejecting low-priority requests.
maria: Confirmed. Capacity-bot shows +85% backlog on the p4 pool, spot nodes failing to come up. p99 latency creeping.
chris: Any recent deploys or config changes?
maria: No customer-facing deploys. We had a maintenance window on the spot pool 10m ago; autoscaler couldn't replenish because instance types were constrained. Kicking off scale-up now.
capacity-bot: autoscaler: scale-up request submitted -> +8 p4 nodes (ETA ~3m). Request id: su-1854321000
tess: We should enable per-model throttles immediately and consider routing a fraction to a quant/7b variant.
alex: Agreed. Route 20% of non-SLA traffic to mosaic-13b-7b-8k-quant and reduce source qps by 30% for this model in ap-south. Also enable KV prefix caching for hot keys.
raj: Also propose a degrade policy for free tier: fallback to the 8-bit variant when queue > 80 for 3m.
maria: Working on a quick rollback-safe change. Command I'll run:
```
# create canary: 5% traffic -> quant variant, throttle 30% for non-sla
rbctl route update --region ap-south-1 --model mosaic-13b-8k --canary-model mosaic-13b-7b-8k-quant --canary-weight 0.05 --throttle-non-sla 0.30
```
chris: :thumbsup: Start canary to 5% first, monitor errors and quality metrics.
routing-bot: routing: canary created id=canary-1854321000, 5% -> mosaic-13b-7b-8k-quant
maria: Also bump admission batching window to 1.5s to get better batching efficiency while temporary. Will watch p99 closely.
alex: Careful — increasing window can hurt tail latency for real-time customers. Ensure we only do it for background/low-prio lanes.
maria: Noted; applying only to background lanes. Current p99 is 820ms and rising. If p99 exceeds 1.2s we roll back.
tess: If autoscaler doesn't land nodes, plan B is cross-region reroute (eu-west) for 30% traffic, but that's cross-region and will spike egress/cost. Keep as last resort.
raj: Cost estimate for cross-region failover is ~+25% per-token. Prefer throttles + local fallback first.
maria: Scale-up completed: +8 nodes healthy. Queue depth dropping: now 34.
capacity-bot: monitor: queue_depth(mosaic-13b-8k, ap-south-1) = 34; nodes_added = 8
alex: Nice. Keep canary for 10m, then ramp if quality and error rates look good.
chris: I'll add a temporary pager rule: if queue_depth > 100 for 5m or p99 > 1.2s escalate to oncall infra.
routing-bot: monitor: canary-1854321000 error_rate = 0.2% | quality-delta = within threshold
maria: Good. We'll document changes and follow up with a short postmortem to update spot pool thresholds and autoscaler backoff.
tess: Loop closed for now. We'll adjust the throttling policy and add a fallback rule to avoid future 100+ backlogs.
alex: Thanks all. If anyone sees a regression in quality, flag in this thread immediately.
